name: Karela Shot
subtitle: bitter gourd, undiluted, and no pretence that it is pleasant

ingredients.note: the white pith inside is the bitterest part; leave it if you mean it

steps.text: Deseed the karela and chop it. Rubbing the pieces with salt and resting fifteen minutes draws out some bitterness, if that is what you want.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing the pulp.
Stir in the lemon, ginger and black salt. Drink cold and fast.

storage: Same day only. It grows more bitter as it sits.

provenance.note: Karela juice is drunk across India on an empty stomach, most often by people managing blood sugar. Its reputation rests on that rather than on flavour, and nobody pretends otherwise.
